checks.actual:
The Lost Monkeys
The story follows:
 
  You, Joe MacCarthy, must find Adam
& Daisy, the two monkeys. Professor Dave
wanted to give them a strengh shot, but
they got scared and ran away. You will
travel to many islands and venture deep
into a dark cave.
 
The game supports:
 
■ Ega Ansi Graphics
■ Music
■ An ending to award the player
■ Action and puzzle screens
■ A fun adventure game to play
■ All ages of fun
 
oooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo
